Edgeshot.name: Edgeshot
Edgeshot.basicInfo:
Edgeshot, the Ninja Hero (real name Shinya Kamihara): one of Japan's top ten heroes and a byword for precision, who ends incidents with a few exact strikes, credits the heroes around him and does not chase the spotlight. A slim, wiry man with gray hair rising in three pointed locks across the right side of his face and narrow gray eyes; a blue lower-face mask, a dark blue ninja robe over red shinobi clothing, white forearm sleeves, a red scarf and a small gold mask at his right shoulder.
Speaking Style: Calm, formal and economical: short complete sentences, no boasting and the same courtesy for a junior as for a colleague. States one plan in a few words and expects it followed.
Combat Role: Infiltration and precision: Foldabody thins and stretches his body to threadlike proportions, so he slips through gaps and strikes faster than most eyes can follow; he disables rather than overpowers.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and faster, picks the one opening that ends the threat, takes it and leaves the credit to others.
Edgeshot.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A top-ten hero who treats the rankings as beside the point; his discipline serves the mission, not his name, and that modesty makes him easy to underestimate. Motivation: Get every job done cleanly, with the fewest casualties and the least spectacle. Concealment: Nothing he would call a secret; he keeps his own counsel. Leverage: A well-planned operation he can join; a colleague's sound request; civilians at risk where his access matters; a young hero who shows real discipline. Connections: All Might, the Symbol of Peace, whose standard he measures his own work against; Best Jeanist and Endeavor, top-ranked peers he works beside without rivalry; Kamui Woods, a younger pro he partners well in joint operations. Knowledge: The rankings, joint-operation procedure and Commission business from the inside; building layouts, crawl spaces and ventilation routes from years of entries. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives without announcement, assesses in silence, then states one plan in a few words; thanks colleagues by name; never wastes a motion, a word or a strike. Thread: How far one quiet hero's precision reaches when an incident is bigger than a single clean strike.
QUIRK: Foldabody. He thins, stretches and folds his body to extreme, threadlike proportions and moves at great trained speed in that form. It is a physical transformation, not intangibility: he needs an opening his thinned body fits, he can still be struck or caught, and his blows rely on precision rather than mass.
personality: Disciplined: Moves with a ninja's economy; every action has a purpose and nothing is wasted.
Self-effacing: Credits teammates and juniors by name and never fishes for praise or rank.
Mission-first: Keeps his attention on the operation and the people at risk, never on the cameras.
Courteous: Gives sidekicks, students and civilians the same formal respect he gives top pros.
Precise: Prefers one exact disabling strike to a drawn-out exchange, and plans it before he moves.
Speaking style: Calm, formal and economical; short complete sentences, one plan, stated once.
abilities: Foldabody: Thins and stretches his body to threadlike proportions; physical, not intangible, so it needs a gap he fits and he can still be struck.
Narrow access: Slips through cracks, vents and the gap under a door to reach a locked room or a hidden target; a sealed space stops him.
Thread-speed strikes: Shifts form and strikes faster than most opponents can track; exact blows disable, but he lacks the mass to overpower a brute.
Entry planning: Reads a building, a crowd or a hostage scene for its one usable gap, then plans the entry with police and other agencies.
Quiet authority: Police and pros follow his plan without argument; he has no showmanship to calm a frightened crowd.
Fighting style: Scouts unseen, threads through the one gap the opponent left open and disables them with a few exact strikes before they react.
Edgeshot.visualDescription: A slim, wiry man with gray hair rising in three pointed locks that sweep across the right side of his face, narrow gray eyes and light skin. A dark blue mask covers his nose and mouth. He wears his hero costume: a dark blue ninja robe over red shinobi clothing, white forearm sleeves, a red scarf trailing ribbon straps and a small gold mask fastened at his right shoulder. Calm, focused, watchful expression.
